messages:
Maya (People Ops): quick heads-up — performance cycle timeline + calibration scheduling. Self-reviews are OPEN now and close Mon Apr 6 23:59 PT. Manager reviews due Mon Apr 13 23:59 PT. Calibration week is Apr 15–17. Please review the updated rubric here: https://redwood-internal/docs/reviews/rubric-2026 and submit your calibration packet by Apr 10.

Alex Chen: thanks — can you confirm whether self-reviews are visible to managers as soon as submitted or only after the self-review window closes?

Maya (People Ops): good q — managers can see submitted self-reviews immediately. If you want to hold comments for the manager, add them in the private manager notes section instead. :white_check_mark:

Jamal Price: for calibration packets — what's the expected format? Do we need attachments or just links?

Maya (People Ops): keep it lightweight. Calibration packet should include:
- one-paragraph summary of performance (2–3 sentences)
- 3 concrete impact examples with links to PRs/metrics/demos
- proposed rating + level recommendation
- any context (e.g., role change, extended leave, partial-quarter ramp)
Send links to artifacts (OKR dashboards, PRs) in the packet. If you prefer, paste a short doc link rather than attaching files.

Maria Gonzalez: heads-up for managers: checklist you can copy into the manager review
- review self-review + manager notes
- validate 3 impact examples (links) and add one quantitative outcome when possible
- pick a provisional rating and write 1–2 calibration talking points
- flag promotion candidates early (see note below)
- click "submit for calibration" in the review tool by Apr 10

Alex Chen: schedule conflicts — our managers are across EMEA/APAC. Are there multiple calibration slots?

Maya (People Ops): yes, we created two main calibration blocks to reduce timezone friction:
- Block A: Apr 15, 09:00–11:00 PT (covers Americas & EMEA morning)
- Block B: Apr 16, 16:00–18:00 PT (covers EMEA afternoon & APAC friendly)
Please RSVP to one block in the calendar invite by Apr 8. If you absolutely can't make either, DM me and we'll arrange a catch-up calibration slot.

People Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled: Self-review window closes in 3 days (Apr 6). Link: https://redwood-internal/reviews/self-review-2026 :alarm_clock:

Jamal Price: quick on contractors — include long-term contractors (>3 months) who contribute to scope, but use the "contractor/contributor" rubric variant. No promotions for contractors; include them for calibration conversation but mark them as contractor.

Maya (People Ops): promotions & level changes: if you want to recommend a promotion, include a short promotion packet (current level, target level, justification + artifacts) in addition to the calibration packet. Promotions require calibration sign-off and VP approval — flag any high-confidence cases by Apr 3 so we can route early.

Maria Gonzalez: small operational note — managers: confirm that you have at least one peer example for any rating >= "Exceeded Expectations" to avoid outlier bias.

Alex Chen: got it, copying checklist to my team now. Thanks!

Maya (People Ops): thanks all — final reminders:
- Apr 6: self-reviews close
- Apr 10: manager calibration packets due & submit in tool
- Apr 13: manager reviews due
- Apr 15–17: calibration meetings
If anything unclear DM me or drop in #people-ops. :wave:
